WITH it_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT id
    FROM info_type
    WHERE info = 'mini biography'
),
lt_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT id
    FROM link_type
    WHERE link = 'features'
),
t_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT id, title
    FROM title
    WHERE production_year BETWEEN 1980 AND 1984
),
pi_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT person_id, info_type_id
    FROM person_info
    WHERE note = 'Volker Boehm'
),
candidate_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        n.name,
        t_filtered.title,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY n.name NULLS LAST) AS rn_name,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t_filtered.title NULLS LAST) AS rn_title
    FROM t_filtered
    JOIN movie_link AS ml ON ml.linked_movie_id = t_filtered.id
    JOIN lt_filtered ON lt_filtered.id = ml.link_type_id
    JOIN cast_info AS ci ON ci.movie_id = t_filtered.id
    JOIN name AS n ON n.id = ci.person_id
    JOIN aka_name AS an ON an.person_id = n.id
    JOIN pi_filtered ON pi_filtered.person_id = n.id
    JOIN it_filtered ON it_filtered.id = pi_filtered.info_type_id
    WHERE an.name LIKE '%a%'
      AND n.name_pcode_cf LIKE 'D%'
      AND n.gender = 'm'
)
SELECT
    MIN(candidate_rows.name) AS of_person,
    MIN(candidate_rows.title) AS biography_movie
FROM candidate_rows
WHERE candidate_rows.rn_name = 1 OR candidate_rows.rn_title = 1
